headline: Pitzer verified clear of any CPT restriction, and the DHS, Tufts and Claremont McKenna tripwires are unchanged, with no third school found revoking already-approved CPT beyond Davidson and MIT. Franklin & Marshall and Occidental each failed a second straight attempt to find a readable CPT policy page; no school was newly restricted.

context: No CPT-specific litigation. No third broadcast message. DHS's stated position: 'nothing about these regulations has changed.' ICE is auditing schools, with SEVP decertification as the stated risk. Immigration attorneys flag a retroactive-scrutiny risk — past CPT revisited at the OPT, STEM-OPT or H-1B stage. The common institutional reading of the new standard: integral to the curriculum, required of all students in the programme for degree completion, a documented cooperative agreement with the employer, and DSO authorisation before training begins.

runs.summary: Pitzer verified clear, front of the LAC queue: its own dedicated CPT page describes only the standard integral-to-coursework process, no reference to the August guidance. Franklin & Marshall and Occidental each failed a second straight verification attempt (no readable CPT policy page); Scripps failed its first. No school newly restricted; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations, no counter-trend.

No school was newly restricted or cleared this run. Lafayette and Denison parked after a third failed attempt to find a readable CPT page; Franklin & Marshall and Occidental stay queued after an inconclusive first check. Bucknell and Colorado College's parked-school retries failed again (403/404). Tripwires unchanged at DHS, Tufts and Claremont McKenna; no new cancellations, no counter-trend.

Stony Brook newly confirmed restricted via the .edu sweep: CPT continues to be processed but only under the narrowed SEVP standard requiring training essential to degree completion for all students; the university says past departmental approval does not establish continued eligibility, leaving existing CPT's status unclear. Bucknell and Colorado College parked after a third straight failed verification. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations, no counter-trend.

University of Pittsburgh newly restricted, found via the .edu sweep: OIS has paused processing all CPT requests while consulting counsel on what can be approved under the new DHS guidance; existing-approval treatment not addressed. All four LAC-queue deep-checks (Bucknell, Colorado College, Lafayette, Denison) failed to verify. No new cancellations, no counter-trend, tripwires unchanged.

Florida State restricted, front of the national queue: its Center for Global Engagement, citing the 12 Aug SEVP broadcast message, will approve CPT only for degree programmes requiring it of every student (Hospitality Management BS, Planning MS, Clinical Psychology PhD named); existing-approval treatment not addressed. Tulane verified clear. National queue now empty. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations.

RPI restricted from the front of the national queue: its ISSS employment page says that beginning Spring 2027, CPT will be approved only for Discovery Semester co-ops or programmes with an explicit graduation internship requirement — no SEVP guidance cited, current approvals not addressed. Mount Holyoke, Bryn Mawr and Wake Forest verified clear. No new cancellations, no tripwire movement.

Macalester and Case Western Reserve verified clear, both from the front of their queues: Macalester's International Student Programs employment page and Case Western's engineering co-op page each describe only the standard CPT process, no reference to the August guidance. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations.

Holy Cross and William & Mary verified clear, both from the front of their queues: Holy Cross's Office of International Students page and William & Mary's Reves Center CPT page each describe only the standard process, no reference to the August guidance. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations.

University of Georgia verified clear, front of the national queue: its Office of Global Engagement employment page carries only the standard CPT process, no reference to the August guidance. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged, no new cancellations.

Northeastern verified clear: its Office of Global Services CPT page carries only standard eligibility language and its updates feed has no CPT post. No other school changed tier; tripwires unchanged and no new cancellations.
